g.text: Extension taxes less subsidies per item for Germany (DEU), a FABIO-internal decomposition; the World Bank
reference is TOTAL-only, so no WB line is drawn. Taxes less subsidies is the production-side measure
throughout. Blue line/triangles on the Primary (ISIC-A) row(s) = external A01+A03 taxes less subsidies
benchmark (EUROSTAT_NAMA; exported by scripts 02/03), a primary-agriculture, forestry-free reference for the
covered years. Items grouped as "Other" exactly as in the TOTAL figure (below 3% max |share| of WB across
COMBINED-GLORIA extension taxes less subsidies, Germany (DEU) (value-added sub-account)
FABIO-v2 value-added extension, COMBINED-GLORIA, taxes less subsidies (current US$)
